simple.meaning: שֹׁרֶשׁ (shôresh) is a Hebrew word meaning “root.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שֹׁרֶשׁ (H8330) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 4:12, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֹׁרֶשׁ (H8330) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שֹׁרֶשׁ (H8330) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שֹׁרֶשׁ (shôresh) / H8330 is traced through Daniel 4:12, Daniel 4:20, Daniel 4:23 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The leaves of it were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.

timeline.evidenceText: The leaves of it were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.
The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;

“Whereas the king saw a watcher and a holy one coming down from the sky, and saying, ‘Cut down the tree, and destroy it; nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field, and let it be wet with the dew of the sky. Let his portion be with the animals of the field, until seven times pass over him.
